scope: Independent local review of the prepared metadata-only cache handoff. No SSH, tests, prediction payload reads/hashes, model work, jobs, or page-cache advice were performed.

checks.name: fixed file scope and byte-free identity binding
checks.basis: Decoded the source's pinned item list: exactly S3/S4 train+valid NPYs, no S5, dataset, model, or foreign path. Each binds an exact sidecar SHA-256 and producer SHA plus expected NPY path/device/inode/size/mtime. Sidecars are bounded below 1 MB; NPYs are opened read-only with O_NOFOLLOW and checked by fstat. No NPY payload is read or hashed.

checks.name: all-or-nothing pre-advice validation and immutability
checks.basis: The helper verifies all four sidecars, producer hashes, and open-file identities before issuing any advice. It advises only each pinned file descriptor's byte range with POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED, then rechecks descriptor identity and closes every descriptor in finally. It does not unlink, write, chmod, drop global caches, or alter resource limits. An advice error stops the operation; any already-issued advice affects only clean-cache residency, not file bytes.

checks.name: fresh parent and exact headroom decision
checks.basis: Each before/after snapshot requires the same explicit campaign slice, CPU quota 2s, MemoryHigh 18,000,000,000, MemoryMax 20,000,000,000, swap 0, and no populated descendants; cgroup enumeration fails closed above 128 entries. Before advice, current+8,000,000,000 below 17,000,000,000 skips without touching files; otherwise it requires an additional 128,000,000-byte margin. After advice it reports HEADROOM_READY only if the 8-GB reserve fits under 17 GB; otherwise HEADROOM_HOLD. This does not guarantee a reclaimed byte count.

checks.name: bounded caller process
checks.basis: The helper sets 5 CPU-seconds and 128,000,000-byte address-space limits; its systemctl observations have 10-second timeouts each. The documented 30-second outer timeout and single-thread/at-most-one-CPU invocation are caller constraints, not encoded in REMOTE.py. Run outside wnn-campaign.slice so its own PID does not invalidate the required empty-parent test.

checks.name: assert-based safety guards require normal Python mode
checks.basis: Safety checks for exact slice properties, empty descendants, headroom margin, and file metadata use assert. Python optimization (-O or PYTHONOPTIMIZE) removes those guards. Caller must ensure sys.flags.optimize == 0 (for example, clear PYTHONOPTIMIZE and invoke ordinary python) before any execution; the prepared source itself does not enforce this.

root_only_preconditions: Do not invoke until S5 is durably accepted and exact-stopped; root is the sole caller after a fresh post-stop empty-parent observation.

If the fresh parent sample shows current+8 GB <17 GB, expect NO_HANDOFF_NEEDED and no advice. If the advice path runs, stop on any identity/cap/population assertion or HEADROOM_HOLD; do not retry or enlarge limits.
After execution, reconcile the emitted before/after snapshots and unchanged file identities; the operation is metadata-only resource support, not evidence of cache correctness or scientific progress.
